title: Check If Array Pairs Are Divisible by k
summary: Given an array of integers of even length, determine if it's possible to form exactly half the length in pairs where the sum of each pair is divisible by a given integer k.
statement: Given an array of integers of even length, determine if it's possible to form exactly half the length in pairs where the sum of each pair is divisible by a given integer k. Return true if possible, otherwise false.
constraints: arr has even length and may contain negatives.
Partition all occurrences into pairs whose sums are divisible by k.
hints: Normalize every value by value modulo k.
Remainder zero must occur evenly; when k is even, k/2 is covered by the same equality and must pair internally.
Every other remainder r needs one k-r occurrence.
Matching all complementary counts is necessary and lets each bucket be paired exhaustively.
editorial: Matching all complementary counts is necessary and lets each bucket be paired exhaustively.

tests.explanation: Complementary remainder counts match, including the zero-remainder pair.
Remainders one through six pair complementarily.
